commits: Add spec plan for preset migration

requirements.desc: When inspecting the main package after implementation, only `base` may remain as builtin preset content; `src/official-plugins/senti-presets` and non-base official preset content must not be required by runtime source or main repo tests.
requirements.note: R1: main package contains no bundled official preset plugin copy

requirements.desc: When resolving preset chains, the resolver must use builtin `base` plus enabled plugin registry entries and must not fall back to bundled official preset plugin content.
requirements.note: R2: resolveChain uses enabled plugin registry entries and rejects unregistered presets

requirements.desc: When `senti upgrade` sees a non-base `type` whose provider package is missing, it must search at most 100 configured `plugin.sources[]`, add official default source `{ id: "official-presets", type: "git", remote: "git@github.com:SpreadWorks/senti-presets.git" }` when needed, install / enable the provider plugin, record reproducibility metadata for git sources, stop parent-chain traversal at depth 16, and return a non-zero error if any non-base provider in the parent chain cannot be found.
requirements.note: R3: upgrade records reproducibility metadata when provider completion uses a git source

requirements.desc: When a project contains legacy `.senti/presets/<key>` preset content, `senti upgrade` must migrate it to a local plugin source / enabled package or fail with a clear error; directories with `preset.json` keep that manifest, directories without `preset.json` copy parent / scan / chapters from a matching resolved provider when one exists and otherwise become bare presets with parent null, empty scan, and empty chapters; runtime preset resolution must not treat `.senti/presets/<key>` as a leaf override.
requirements.note: R4: upgrade migrates manifestless legacy presets using provider parent scan and chapters

requirements.desc: When resolving `@presets/<key>/...` includes, locale templates, or AGENTS templates, only preset keys present in the enabled preset registry may resolve, and the resolver must search deterministic paths: project-local template root first where that feature exists, then config type order, and for each type its resolved chain from leaf to root with max chain depth 16; include expansion must keep max depth 8 and max include count 32; it must not broadly scan installed plugin `presets/` directories.
requirements.note: R5: @presets includes resolve through project root, config type order, and leaf-to-root chain order

requirements.desc: When plugin preset DataSources need shared helpers currently represented by `pathMatch.*`, they must obtain those helpers through public container APIs, and plugin preset code must not import main package internal preset paths.
requirements.note: R6: plugin preset DataSources use public pathMatch container APIs

requirements.desc: When running main repo tests, the default, scope, and preset discovery paths must not depend on external plugin checkout state, installed plugin state, `src/official-plugins/senti-presets`, or detailed tests for actual official preset names.
requirements.note: R7: main test runner discovery excludes bundled and external official preset tests

requirements.desc: When testing plugin preset foundation behavior in main repo, fixtures and expected values must use generic preset names such as `sample-preset` or `child-preset`, not actual official preset names as implementation conditions.
requirements.note: R8: main contract tests avoid actual official preset names as implementation fixtures

requirements.desc: When CLI behavior changes affect existing project configs, command names and primary option meanings must remain stable, and the spec-local tests must verify success and failure exit-code conditions for provider completion and migration errors.
requirements.note: R9: upgrade keeps --dry-run stable and rejects unsupported arguments with non-zero status

entries.reason: Spec-local tests changed to cover R1 runtime reference scans, R3 default provider completion, and R5 registry-only config-order resolution

entries.resolution: The previous gate failed before validation because upgrade evidence was missing; rerunning worktree upgrade recreated the required artifacts without changing generated docs.

entries.reason: fix: provider source selection and strict preset-chain validation
entries.resolution: Configured provider sources are no longer overridden by ambient official source resolution; upgrade now fails on missing/deep parent chains and legacy preset parse errors include legacy preset context. Test artifacts must be refreshed.

entries.reason: fix: DataSource resolver fallback after bundled preset removal
entries.resolution: createResolver now synthesizes base-only DataSource chains keyed by requested leaves only after strict project and builtin resolution both miss, without loading removed official preset content

entries.reason: fix: project test runner lacked diagnostics for nonzero group status without TAP failure markers
entries.resolution: tests/run.js now emits a concise nonzero group status diagnostic before preserving the failing exit code

entries.reason: fix: test runner preserved child TAP output for nonzero regression diagnostics
entries.resolution: Write captured child stdout/stderr with writeSync and set process.exitCode instead of process.exit so flow artifacts retain complete failure evidence.

entries.reason: fix: preset resolution tests used removed bundled and legacy-local preset contracts
entries.resolution: Extended presetByLeaf/presetsForArch to accept project roots and rewrote direct preset tests to use enabled plugin fixtures; replaced .senti/presets runtime tests with installed-plugin precedence coverage.

entries.reason: fix: remaining unit contracts expected bundled preset scan and legacy local preset validation
entries.resolution: Updated test-runner helper expectations to exclude bundled preset directories and rewired validatePresetChain fixtures through enabled plugin presets plus project-local templates.

entries.reason: fix: test temp projects lacked plugin-backed preset fixtures and scan defaults ignored plugin presets
entries.resolution: Added a test-helper local plugin fixture for temporary legacy preset configs and made docs scan resolve preset defaults with the project root so plugin preset scan patterns participate.

entries.reason: fix: test legacy plugin fixture config metadata was invalid
entries.resolution: The helper now writes a matching local plugin source plus deterministic 40-character commit metadata for the generated legacy-test-presets package.

entries.reason: fix: pass project root and preset types into AGENTS template callers
entries.resolution: R5 gate found src/setup.js and src/docs/commands/agents.js were loading AGENTS.senti.md without registry context. Both now pass projectRoot and presetTypes so AGENTS lookup follows project-local and enabled preset chain resolution.

entries.reason: fix: lower integration guardrail prompt budget after model context exhaustion
entries.resolution: The worktree gate accepted the compacted prompt but the model ran out of context. MAX_GUARDRAIL_TARGET_CHARS is reduced to 250000 so large migration diffs still preserve added-line evidence while staying within model context.
